footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Nexstar: includes $26.0M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $17.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 8.5% to $4.9B in 2025. Operating income fell 33.0% to $849M, a 17.2% margin.
Net income fell 86.9% to $92.0M, or $3.00 per share. Operating cash flow was $891M and free cash flow $743M, versus $1.1B; Nexstar returned $351M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Nexstar Media Group, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
